review_evidence: README describes a library for bitblasting IEEE-754 floating-point multiplication and exhibits the proved mul_one_is_id theorem, with references to the IEEE and SMT-LIB floating-point semantics.
The 61 primary Lean files cover addition, multiplication, division, FMA, rounding, remainder, square root, conversion, SMT-LIB semantics, proofs, and derived theorems.
A declaration scan finds 1061 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations, establishing a substantial independently searchable formal specification/proof corpus.
summary: Retain fp-lean, a large verified IEEE-754 floating-point semantics and bitblasting library with arithmetic correctness theorems.
